bio: Built in the 13 th century, The Red Lion Hotel is the oldest purpose-built hotel in Europe! Located right in Salisbury city centre, you'll be able to enjoy your afternoon tea in an 800 year old oak-beamed lounge by an open fire, or during the summer months you can dine al fresco in the picturesque courtyard.  Indulge in a seasonal selection of fresh finger sandwiches, petit fours and scones. All washed down with English tea, or make it sparkle with a glass of prosecco!  Vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free afternoon tea options are all available.
